pages.title: Using the Table
pages.text: Put an $(thing)ingredient$() at the bottom left and a $(thing)tool$() above it. Choose a recipe in the middle, then take the result from the right.$(br2)Native recipes consume one ingredient and one tool durability, or one tool if it has no durability.$(br2)Choose between recipes like a $(thing)stonecutter$().

pages.title: Sharing the Table
pages.text: Only $(thing)one player$() can use a table at a time. Other players are told it is occupied.$(br2)The right slot previews the result. Materials are consumed when you take it. Closing the interface clears the preview.

pages.title: Farmer's Delight
pages.text: With $(thing)Farmer's Delight$() installed, the table accepts loaded cutting board recipes, including mod and data pack recipes.$(br2)Use the required ingredient and tool. Counts, chances and Fortune follow the cutting board.$(br2)Farmer's Delight is optional.

pages.title: Cutting Board Results
pages.text: The right slot previews the main result. Outputs roll only when taken.$(br2)All rolled outputs are delivered together. Extras enter your inventory or drop if full.$(br2)Unbreaking works. Tools without durability are kept.
